title: What your furnace filter actually does

scenes.text: Every bit of air your furnace heats gets pulled through one filter first.
scenes.voice: Every bit of air your furnace heats gets pulled through one filter first.

scenes.text: It catches the dust so the machine doesn’t have to.
scenes.voice: It catches the dust, so the machine doesn't have to.

scenes.text: But almost nobody changes it. Month after month it clogs, and the air can’t get through.
scenes.voice: But almost nobody changes it. Month after month it clogs, and the air can't get through.

scenes.text: Now the system works harder, your bill goes up, and an expensive machine wears out early.

scenes.text: The fix takes a minute. Slide the old one out, slide a new one in. Basic filters need it every 1 to 3 months.
